verdict.rationale: Workable documents a no-code, branded, mobile-friendly careers page with custom layout, colors, fonts, and media, plus built-in search and filtering. It also offers an automatically updating job-list widget that embeds on your existing website, which gets jobs onto your own site with minimal effort. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of hosting the careers page on a custom domain (CNAME/own domain), explicit statement that jobs auto-publish to the page when opened in the ATS, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
